cover_headline: Gukesh Visits Tirumala Temple Ahead of World Chess Championship Title Defence
facts: World champion D Gukesh, 20, offered prayers at the Tirumala Sri Venkateswara Swamy Temple in Andhra Pradesh on Friday, November 6, ahead of his title defence
He defends his crown against Uzbekistan's Javokhir Sindarov in a 14-game classical match in Geneva from November 24 to December 12; the first player to 7.5 points wins, with a $2.5 million prize fund
Both players will be 20 when the match begins, making it the youngest World Championship battle in chess history

end.headline: Gukesh Visits Tirumala Temple Ahead of World Chess Championship Title Defence
end.line: The 20-year-old world champion offered prayers at Tirumala on November 6 before facing Javokhir Sindarov in a 14-game title match in Geneva from November 24 to December 12.
